decision: withhold both smooth replacements; retain corrected V53 and close this workload architecture batch
summary: Neither smooth arm earns adoption. The bounded mean removes negative predictions but worsens public and full-population playing time. The squared arm has serious lower-minor allocation errors. Seventeen actual reviews cover gains, harms, ordinary cases, absent MLB regulars and never-arrived lower-minor prospects. Source history is preserved; bounds and solver convergence do not supply baseball validation. Shared calendar indicators create an important representation warning, so these losses do not reject all smooth or bounded models.
next_step: Close the workload architecture batch. Retain V53 opportunity for the next compatible talent and delivered-value comparison. Carry the calendar-context warning into its representation contract: cancellation and reorganization must describe source/history context rather than justify an unqualified uniform PA award. No post-result blend, subgroup routing or penalty sweep; no protected 2026 access or deployed forecast change.

cases.name: Aaron Judge
cases.note: His 696/633/114 MLB PA and 62/39/9 HR enter both arms. The bounded mean replays eta 0.535 into 504 PA, essentially unchanged from 507 baseline versus 458 actual. Smooth squared raises use to 605 and worsens PA, yet improves offense because fixed hitting 3.259 undershoots realized 5.312. That offset is not a coherent workload win. Captured on-40 listing zero is not proof he lacks a job; dated December re-signing remains in the reviewed source context. Healthy workload peers include Ramirez and Turner, not equal availability outcomes.

cases.name: Aaron Judge
cases.note: The actual 410-PA/19-HR AAA record, 95 MLB PA with 42 K, scouting score .70 and roster listing are received. Smooth forecasts 209, bounded 199 versus 281 baseline and 678 actual. Bounded scouting +.716 is partly offset by its prior-debut interaction -.659; these are additive predictor terms, not causal scouting effects. Both still lose fast growth, while fixed hitting -.040 misses realized 5.557. Moya and Austin's failed or short outcomes explain why broadly similar brief-debut players cannot all be treated as certain stars.

cases.name: Fernando Tatis Jr.
cases.note: Prior 546 PA/42 HR and short-season 257/17 remain actual talent samples; the demonstrated capacity reference is about 695, not actual 2020 PA. Smooth raises expected PA 35 to 211, bounded only to 72 versus 635. The bounded unresolved-status term is -.179 predictor units; neither method models remaining games in the known finite 80-game suspension explicitly. No comparable training person matches this broad absence/capacity profile. Hitting 1.289 is near realized 1.271, so improved playing time genuinely improves offense, but the uncertainty and source limitations remain.

cases.name: Matt McLain
cases.note: The prior 403 MLB PA/16 HR and 180 AAA PA/12 HR are present despite current absence. The bounded head yields eta -2.766 and only 47 PA; smooth gives 142, both below the 174 baseline versus 577 actual. Corrected plain October roster return does not prove clinical recovery, but this is still an inadequate comeback mean. Only two broadly matching training people exist. Its fixed hitting .251 versus realized -1.140 also matters: the baseline's close offense partly reflects offsetting errors, not correct underlying estimates. Mauricio's 184 PA and Franco/Marcano zero outcomes remain in the peer evidence.

cases.name: Gavin Lux
cases.note: Prior 471/381 MLB PA and the known knee-surgery/November activation context remain visible. Smooth moves 217 to 242, a small improvement versus actual 487. Bounded drops to 138 even with roster +1.286 predictor units and positive possible-absence term .228. The latter is a fitted association, not evidence that injury helps playing time. Profile support is twelve people and the mechanically close stage peers all have zero returns; they are not matched knee-recovery evidence. Fixed hitting -.243 is reasonably near -.388, so bounded loss is mainly opportunity here.

cases.name: Wander Franco
cases.note: Current 491 PA/17 HR, low K and roster listing drive large means despite cutoff-known unresolved restricted/administrative leave. Smooth gives 519 and bounded 599 versus baseline 543 and actual zero. The bounded restriction term -.088 is too small to offset normal-role evidence. Generic Gorman/Harris/Greene/Garcia peers are not matched legal-status cases. This flags unresolved availability requiring explicit scenarios; it does not authorize using a later ban as a known permanent origin exclusion.

cases.name: Wyatt Langford
cases.note: His 200 minor PA include 54 AA PA/4 HR and 26 AAA PA, with a strong .818 draft score. Bounded draft term +.942 enters, but the full predictor remains -3.665, only 20 PA versus 43 baseline, 95 smooth and 557 actual. The broad profile has 2,430 people, not thousands of comparable fourth-pick rapid movers. Bannister, Veen, Wilken and Morales all fail to receive next-year MLB PA. This arm worsens readiness; it does not show pedigree is unhelpful or solve elite thin-sample entry.

cases.name: Yordan Alvarez
cases.note: His 561 PA/37 HR and prior 598/33 imply strong offensive history. Smooth raises 512 baseline PA to 647 and bounded to 621 versus 496 actual. The saved bounded predictor 1.246 reconstructs this overestimate. Both improve delivered offense only because fixed hitting 2.814 is far below realized 5.273: wrong workload partly compensates for low talent. Tucker/Torres reach 674/672 PA while Mountcastle/Urias receive 470/177, showing real availability variability. Corrected prior roster closure is not assurance of a full healthy future season.

cases.name: Nelson Cruz
cases.note: Three years of 591/645/667 PA and 37/39/43 HR support a durable veteran with real talent, despite age 37 and captured roster listing zero. Smooth improves 288 baseline to 415 versus 521 actual, largely through current/recent workload; bounded stays at 284. Both retain hitting 1.683 versus realized 5.361, so substantial offense remains missed. Kinsler, Pujols, Zobrist and Bautista's mixed 281/545/176/0 next-year PA warn against guaranteeing every older regular a job. The largest smooth value gain does not establish that arm's overall validity.

cases.name: Ronald Acuña Jr.
cases.note: Current 735 PA/41 HR with 84 K, prior 533 PA and captured listing support a strong regular. Smooth predicts 754 and bounded 717 versus 582 baseline and 222 actual. Current workload and role dominate the squared predictor; bounded roster +1.286 and related role terms reconstruct its high mean. The later adverse season is not a cutoff-known fact, and contemporaneous Rutschman/Kwan/Hoerner/Torres mostly retain regular workloads. Forecasting well above 700 expected PA leaves little room for ordinary attrition and amplifies delivered-value downside. Fixed hitting also overshoots realized .251.

cases.name: Mauricio Dubón
cases.note: His 428/492/265 PA and 4/10/5 HR describe a useful partial-workload player. Smooth predicts 323 and bounded 301 versus baseline 340 and 398 actual. Smooth offense .341 is almost exact to .340 actual, but that does not validate its worse PA: fixed hitting -1.240 is less poor than realized -1.363, offsetting missing use. Broad profile support is 522. Heim/Lowe/Raley/McKinstry have mixed 433/553/219/511 PA, not identical future jobs. The ordinary case demonstrates why component errors must remain visible beside a close product.

cases.name: Aaron Judge
cases.note: After 458 PA/37 HR, prior 696/62 and 633/39, bounded predicts 622 versus 527 baseline and 704 actual; smooth is almost unchanged at 530. Bounded eta 1.248, roster +1.286 and retained workload reconstruct its useful regular-return gain. Fixed hitting 3.360 versus realized 7.086 remains the bigger superstar miss. Frazier, Profar, Flores and Yelich show sharply different 294/668/242/315 next-year use, so this largest bounded value gain is a development diagnostic, not a rule to boost every previously productive partial season.

cases.name: Freddie Freeman
cases.note: 695 current MLB PA/31 HR, 692 PA in 2019 and 262 actual short-2020 PA are all present. Bounded collapses to 278 and smooth to 400 versus 560 baseline and 708 actual. Captured listing zero and unknown scouting sentinel -1 are not evidence of zero talent or a clinical absence; several correlated terms partially cancel. The 2021 actual training set has no varying reorganization or lag-one cancellation flag, while 2020 histories are abnormal. His miss belongs to a severe origin-wide opportunity deficit, not merely an unpredictable player disappointment. All selected recent-workload peers still get 477 to 617 PA.

cases.name: Tyler Stephenson
cases.note: Back-to-back 515/517 MLB PA and current 19 HR raise smooth to 433 and bounded to 455 versus baseline 388 and actual 342. Bounded offense 1.353 nearly equals actual 1.353, selected as an ordinary value case, but only because fixed hitting -.091 understates realized +.499 while workload overshoots. The additive predictor .277 reproduces the mean, with roster/role evidence positive. Profile support 508 and catcher position are observed, but this test adds no catcher-defense or position WAR. Langeliers reaches 523 PA while Vierling gets 100; close product is not exact role prediction.

cases.name: Matt Duffy
cases.note: The lower-minors label comes from eight A-plus rehab PA, not an inexperienced lower-minor prospect: he already has prior 366/612 MLB PA. Smooth improves baseline 172 to 243, bounded worsens to 126 versus 560 actual, with zero matching broad training people. This stage label must be read jointly with prior debut and demonstrated capacity. The largest lower-minor actual use and largest bounded forecast happen to be the same veteran, so additional never-debut lower cases are required. His generic Arruebarrena/Montero/Triunfel/Lutz peers all fail to return; they do not establish medical or talent equivalence.

cases.name: Juan Soto
cases.note: At age 18 he has 96 A-ball PA with three HR and eight K, plus 27 complex PA; prior complex production includes 183 PA/five HR/25 K. No MLB/AAA/AA exposure, draft evidence or current scouting rank enters. Baseline .13, smooth 4.34 and bounded 1.10 PA all miss 494 next-year MLB PA and strong hitting. Broad support of 2,686 similar age/stage people masks absence of elite matched evidence. Brito/Rodriguez/Abbott/Narvaez all receive zero next-year PA. This is a real exceptional fast-path miss, not proof every young productive lower-minor hitter should get hundreds of next-year PA or that next-year mean equals long-term prospect value.

cases.name: Anthony Alford
cases.note: 401 A-plus PA with nine HR and 117 K, scouting .59 and a roster listing give this never-debut lower-minor player the largest bounded mean among that group. Bounded 54.49 improves baseline 71.40 versus only eight actual PA; smooth worsens to 145.69. Roster +1.297 and scouting +.638 enter the bounded predictor, so evidence has not been ignored. Realized rate -8.005 comes from eight PA and is not a reliable talent estimate. All origin-nearest peers get zero MLB PA. The contrast with Soto shows that generic age/workload peers and scouting summaries do not identify rare star pathways, and aggressive broad boosts would create many false positives.
